newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Evea Bank eyes stock market quote.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Evea Bank eyes stock market quote.

text.p: Small Estonian bank Evea Bank is considering a quotation on the country's stock market next month, bank officials said on Monday.
"The bank is seeking a listing on the secondary list," an Evea Bank spokesman told Reuters, confirming an article in newspaper Aripaev.
Stock exchange managing director Helo Meigas said the bank had so far not made an official request for the listing.
"If they follow all the rules very properly, the quotation commission might make a decision just before Christmas," Meigas said.
EVEA Bank is one of the smallest Estonian banks and had net assets in October of 331 million kroons, a 25 percent rise since the end of 1995.
The main Estonian stock market list is currently made up of the largest commercial banks, including market leader Hansapank.
